name: radio-group
title: Radio Group
description: A plan chooser: a card lists four subscription rows, each with a small circle, a name, a short description and a price. Clicking a row moves the single selection and highlights that row.
use: Exactly one of a few clearly labelled options must be chosen and easy comparison matters.
avoid: Rows show only two short lines, so plans needing feature lists are better built as cards.
a11y: Arrow keys move the choice and labels are linked by id, but the chosen row is communicated mostly by colour and a 6px dot. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A dark rounded card with a bold 'Choose a plan' heading and one muted line, then four stacked rows. Each row holds a small circle, a bold plan name over a dim description, and a price at the right; the chosen row gets a lighter border and fill.
behaves: Clicking a row fills its circle with a dot and moves the lighter border to it, so only one stays chosen. The change is instant, and keyboard focus draws a ring around the circle.
customise: You supply the rows and circles as children; value or defaultValue controls the choice, and colours, gap and row styling come from classes.
weight: light: Four small circles and labels with colour transitions only.
